name: Sea otter
description: Sea otter (Enhydra lutris), a single species tracked by the source. A keystone benthic predator: diet studies in PWS (Montague Strait) found clams dominating its diet (about 81% by weight), with crabs, mussels, octopus and echinoderms making up the rest - represented in the model as feeding on infaunal zoobenthos. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in tonnes wet weight per km2, from Table 23 of the source.
